title: 100 Crore Second = Poore 31 Saal!
idea: How hugely different 1 million, 10 million, 1 billion and 1 trillion seconds are when counted in days and years, shown in lakh and crore.

lines.text: 100 crore second ginne baitho, toh poore 31 saal lag jayenge!
Shuru karte hain: 10 lakh second? Sirf 11 din mein khatam!
1 crore second mein Chaand Prithvi ke 4 chakkar laga leta hai!
Aur 100 crore second? Seedha 100 guna, yaani 11,574 din!
Aur 1 lakh crore second? Seedha 31,700 saal peeche pahunch jaoge!
Lakh aur crore mein itna bada fark! Aapka guess kya tha? Comment karo!

youtube.title: 100 Crore Second = 31 Saal?! Lakh vs Crore Ka Asli Fark 🤯 #shorts
youtube.description:
10 lakh second sirf 11 din ke hote hain, lekin 100 crore second ginne mein poore 31 saal lag jayenge! Aur 1 lakh crore second? 31,700 saal! Numbers ka ye scale dekh ke dimaag hil jayega.
#shorts #hindifacts #amazingfacts #mathfacts #hinglish

facts.claim: 10 million (1 crore) seconds ≈ 115.7 days; at a Moon sidereal orbital period of about 27.3 days, that is about 4.2 orbits of Earth
1 trillion (1 lakh crore) seconds ≈ 31,688 years, which rounds to about 31,700
